qualificationPolicy.ageRoutingMeaning: Explicit contiguous application routing avoids artificial 0.1-year gaps between table labels. Not a recovered author age-rounding algorithm. Upper cap <18 is conservative pediatric scope; source group labels, medians and N are not rewritten.
qualificationPolicy.firstBirthday: Exactly 1 year retains existing Ljubicic. A range starting at 1 and extending above 1 crosses sources and remains unavailable; never route using midpoint.
qualificationPolicy.qualification: Unknown/absent assay or specimen allows explicitly educational comparison without claiming compatibility. Known incompatible assay/specimen or contraindication blocks patient/reference points. Source-specific compatibleSpecimenIds preserve the existing default serum policy of other profiles.
qualificationPolicy.geometry: Existing curves, normalization maxima, zoom projections and source marker independence remain unchanged. New ordinary profiles do not activate puberty sex-comparison points.
qualificationPolicy.laboratoryNorms: No reference interval, threshold, classification, diagnostic verdict, unit conversion or snapshot change.

ordinaryInhibinChildhoodExtension.numericMeaning: Source median at age 6 is approximately 11 pg/mL. A result of 33 lies above that median; this alone is not an above-reference-range classification.
limitations: Female Gen II LOD 3 pg/mL; median ~11 is not a sub-LOD or LOD/2 value.
Approximately ±2 pg/mL is graphical reading tolerance, not a confidence interval or clinical reference interval.
Dense red observations obscure some early-childhood curve pixels. Existing approximate digitization is retained; no independent high-precision re-extraction claimed.
Age-specific sample counts and original numerical LMS coefficients are not supplied by retained materials.
Whole possible age must lie in the active domain; no midpoint selection across a boundary.
Chronological age does not determine Tanner stage and this age-model profile does not require Th1.
